Niche plots

Source: R/plotting.R
nichePlots.Rd

plotNicheSpatial() shows the cells of one niche in one image. nicheCompositionMap() shows the relative enrichment of each cell type in each niche as a bubble plot or heatmap. nicheBarplot() shows it for a single niche. nicheProportionBoxplot() compares a niche's per-image proportion between outcome groups.

Usage

plotNicheSpatial(spe, imageID, niche, nicheCol = "nicheWeighted", cellSize = 1)

nicheCompositionMap(
  spe,
  niche,
  cellType = "cellType",
  type = c("bubble", "heatmap"),
  limit = c(0.33, 3),
  ...
)

nicheBarplot(spe, niche, target, cellType = "cellType", limit = c(0.33, 3))

nicheProportionBoxplot(proportions, niche, spe, outcomeCol)

Arguments

spe

A SummarizedExperiment (e.g. a SpatialExperiment) with the cell type, image and coordinates of every cell in the form given by getCellData().

imageID

The image to plot.

niche

For plotNicheSpatial() and the proportion boxplot, the niche to show. For nicheCompositionMap() and nicheBarplot(), the niche assignments: either a vector of niches named by cell ID, such as niches$nicheWeighted from runNicheIdentification(), or the name of a colData column holding them.

nicheCol

The niche assignments for plotNicheSpatial(), in either of the forms taken by niche in nicheCompositionMap().

cellSize

Size of the highlighted cells in plotNicheSpatial(), the cells of the chosen niche. The grey background cells always have size 0.7.

cellType

Column of colData(spe) with cell type labels.

type

"bubble" or "heatmap".

limit

Lower and upper limit of the relative enrichment.

...

Further arguments passed to pheatmap::pheatmap().

target

The niche to plot in nicheBarplot().

proportions

The propWeighted or propUnweighted element of the results of testNicheOutcome(): the table you pass decides whether the weighted or the unweighted niches are plotted.

outcomeCol

Name of the per-image outcome column in colData(spe).

Value

A ggplot object; for nicheProportionBoxplot() a girafe (interactive) widget; for nicheCompositionMap(type = "heatmap") the result of pheatmap::pheatmap().

Examples

data(lungSubset)
data(lungCellTypeTree)
data(lungConfList)
niches = runNicheIdentification(lungSubset, lungCellTypeTree, lungConfList,
    r = 50, k = 6)
#> Computing unweighted LISA curves...
#> Generating local indicators of spatial association.
#> Computing weighted LISA curves...
#> Generating local indicators of spatial association.
#> Clustering niches...
plotNicheSpatial(lungSubset, "VUHD113", "niche1",
    nicheCol = niches$nicheWeighted)

nicheCompositionMap(lungSubset, niches$nicheWeighted)

nicheBarplot(lungSubset, niches$nicheWeighted, "niche1")

res = testNicheOutcome(lungSubset, niches$nicheUnweighted,
    niches$nicheWeighted, outcomeCol = "disease_status", subject = "subject")
if (requireNamespace("ggiraph", quietly = TRUE)) {
    nicheProportionBoxplot(res$propWeighted, "niche1", lungSubset,
        "disease_status")
    nicheProportionBoxplot(res$propUnweighted, "niche1", lungSubset,
        "disease_status")
}
